title: Best candidate: clean passive table (X01) + auto-gain (X05) + equal weight per position (X04)
hypothesis: The Stage B best candidate C01 (meets criteria 1-3 on YES+EG, fails the noise criterion because of YES -0.49) plus the JM passive-table bug fix generalises to the 4 subjects not used for screening.
